items.thread_text: 東尼獎編劇史提夫·薩特（Steven Sater），花了20年才把他的尼祿大帝音樂劇《Nero》帶上倫敦舞台。這部作品2006年曾在舊金山上演。薩特說，劇中這位暴君角色和川普有驚人的相似之處，他也談到自己如何把甘迺迪遇刺的故事，寫成一則希臘悲劇。
items.threads_text:
東尼獎編劇史提夫·薩特（Steven Sater），花了20年，才把他的尼祿大帝音樂劇《Nero》帶上倫敦舞台。這部作品2006年曾在舊金山上演，如今終於迎來第二次完整製作。

薩特談到，劇中這位暴君角色和川普有驚人的相似之處，他也談到自己如何把甘迺迪遇刺的故事，寫成一則希臘悲劇。他說：「我覺得，我的作品對補助劇場來說太貴，對商業劇場來說又太冒險。」
items.voice_text: 一位東尼獎編劇，花了20年，才把他的音樂劇搬上倫敦舞台。史提夫·薩特的作品《尼祿》，講的是古羅馬暴君尼祿。他說，劇中這個角色和川普有驚人的相似之處。他也談到，怎麼把甘迺迪遇刺的故事，寫成一則希臘悲劇。

sources.summary: It took the Tony winner 20 years to bring his ‘showman’ tyrant to London. He reflects on its Trumpian parallels, the death of Spring Awakening’s Duncan Sheik and the horrific accident that led him to ancient classics Before Spring Awakening won eight Tony awards in 2007, its dramatist and lyricist Steven Sater had “been struggling financially and professionally for quite a while,” he remembers. “Everyone said at the time: this is where it all starts!” Sater and composer Duncan Sheik thought their next success would be Nero, about the Roman emperor who murdered his mother among many others, which had been produced in San Francisco in 2006. But only now, after two decades of workshops and showcases for potential backers, is Nero receiving its second full professional production. “I think maybe my work is too expensive for subsidised theatre and too risky for commercial theatre,” Sater says. “I don’t think that – audiences respond to my work – but I suspect producers may believe it.” Continue reading...

sources.summary: Not only did Craig insist his 007 die at the end of his run, but now we learn from Dench’s memoir that it was his idea to kill her off too. How will the next Bond top that? Shoot a puppy? Now that the next James Bond actor is on the brink of being unveiled , it may be a good time to take a proper look at the prior 007 with clear eyes. Because, while the reputations of all the previous Bonds have ossified over the years – in chronological order: sexy, wooden, camp, boring and silly – the Daniel Craig era is finally coming into focus. And it turns out that he was actually the angel of death. Obviously anyone who saw No Time to Die knows this, because that film ended with Bond being exploded in a hail of missile fire. But according to Judi Dench’s new memoir Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It? , it was also Craig’s decision to kill off M, too. Continue reading...
